records.source: You probably wouldn't like it inside my cabin. It's dark and full of spiders.$s
records.translation: Malamang ay hindi mo magugustuhan ang loob ng Kubo ko. Madilim at punô iyon ng mga gagamba.$s

records.source: Please excuse the sorry state of my cabin.
records.translation: Pagpasensiyahan mo ang kaawa-awang kalagayan ng Kubo ko.

records.source: Some people are shy. Keep showing interest in them and they'll get comfortable around you.#$e#Everyone likes to have friends, even that grumpy blacksmith.
records.translation: Mahiyain ang ilang tao. Patuloy kang magpakita ng interes at magiging palagay sila sa iyo.#$e#Gusto ng lahat na magkaroon ng mga kaibigan, kahit ang bugnuting panday na iyon.

records.source: Hello. I hope your new farming life is panning out as you'd hoped?
records.translation: Kumusta. Umaayon ba sa inaasahan mo ang bago mong buhay sa pagsasaka?

records.source: Oh, @! I was hoping you'd show up.#$e#It's always a pleasure to see you.$h
records.translation: Ah, @! Inaasahan kong darating ka.#$e#Laging ikinagagalak kitang makita.$h

records.source: Mystery, huh? It's definitely an exciting genre. I'll remember that.
records.translation: Misteryo, ha? Talagang kapana-panabik na uri iyon. Tatandaan ko iyan.

records.source: Ah, one of the classic genres. I'll remember that.
records.translation: Ah, isa sa mga klasikong uri. Tatandaan ko iyan.

records.source: I would've never guessed! I suppose even those of the 'earthiest' profession sometimes have their heads in the stars.$h#$b#I'll remember that.
records.translation: Hindi ko nahulaan kailanman! Siguro ay nakatingala rin minsan sa mga bituin kahit ang mga taong ang hanapbuhay ay nakaugat sa lupa.$h#$b#Tatandaan ko iyan.

records.source: ... I was worried you might not feel this way about another man.$l^So am I.$l
records.translation: ... Nag-alala akong baka hindi ganito ang nararamdaman mo tungkol sa ibang lalaki.$l^Ganoon din ako.$l

records.source: Oh! I'm so sorry.$8%fork
records.translation: Ah! Humihingi ako ng paumanhin.$8%fork

records.source: Well...okay.#$b#Here's to @!
records.translation: Aba... sige.#$b#Para kay @!

records.source: That's a great idea!$h#$b#Here's to us!
records.translation: Napakagandang ideya!$h#$b#Para sa atin!

records.source: Hmmph...forget it.$a
records.translation: Hmmph... kalimutan mo na.$a

records.source: Ah, to a harmonious future for the community... what a virtuous idea.#$b#Here's to Pelican Town!
records.translation: Ah, para sa maayos na hinaharap ng komunidad... kaybuting ideya.#$b#Para sa Bayan ng Pelican!

records.source: A gentle little sunbeam woke me up this morning. I've never felt so refreshed.$u#$e#I'm sorry if that isn't very interesting to you.
records.translation: Ginising ako ng banayad na sinag ng araw kaninang umaga. Hindi pa ako nakadama ng ganitong sigla.$u#$e#Paumanhin kung hindi iyon gaanong interesante para sa iyo.

records.source: I know that I am kind of an 'oddball'.#$e#I hope you don't mind.$h
records.translation: Alam kong medyo “kakaiba” ako.#$e#Sana ay ayos lang sa iyo.$h

records.source: @, I know you have faith in my abilities as a writer. That means a lot to me.$h
records.translation: @, alam kong nananalig ka sa kakayahan ko bilang manunulat. Napakahalaga niyan sa akin.$h

records.source: I've encountered some beautiful shells in front of my house.#$e#I would imagine the rarer varieties to be quite valuable.
records.translation: May natagpuan akong ilang magagandang kabibe sa harap ng bahay ko.#$e#Palagay ko ay napakahalaga ng mga mas pambihirang uri.

records.source: I write in hopes of connecting with others through time and space.$u#$e#*sigh*...times are changing, though. People don't read anymore.$s
records.translation: Nagsusulat ako sa pag-asang makaugnay sa iba sa kabila ng panahon at layo.$u#$e#*Buntong-hininga*... Pero nagbabago ang panahon. Hindi na nagbabasa ang mga tao.$s

records.source: It must be satisfying to follow your crop from seed to harvest.#$e#It's as if your essence is infused into the fruit.$u
records.translation: Tiyak na kasiya-siyang subaybayan ang pananim mula binhi hanggang anihan.#$e#Para bang humahalo sa bunga ang mismong diwa mo.$u

records.source: Oh dear! My shoes are filled with sand.$s#$e#That's the trouble with living on the beach.
records.translation: Naku po! Punô ng buhangin ang sapatos ko.$s#$e#Iyan ang problema sa pagtira sa dalampasigan.

records.source: @? You look puzzled.#$b#I guess the hot summer air can make us a little dizzy.
records.translation: @? Mukha kang nalilito.#$b#Siguro ay medyo nahihilo tayo sa mainit na hangin ng tag-init.

records.source: The sun is angry today... My skin is a bit too delicate, I'm afraid.
records.translation: Galit ang araw ngayon... Natatakot akong medyo maselan ang balat ko.

records.source: You came all the way here just to talk to me? How kind.$h
records.translation: Nagpunta ka pa hanggang dito para lang kausapin ako? Napakabait mo.$h

records.source: Visit my cabin whenever you like. I could use the company.$h
records.translation: Dalawin mo ang Kubo ko anumang oras na gusto mo. Makabubuti sa akin ang may kasama.$h

records.source: Hello @.#$e#Make sure and take breaks from your work now and then.
records.translation: Kumusta, @.#$e#Tiyaking magpahinga paminsan-minsan mula sa trabaho.

records.source: Come visit me if you need a break from your labors.$h#$e#I'm usually at my house.
records.translation: Dalawin mo ako kung kailangan mong magpahinga mula sa mga gawain mo.$h#$e#Karaniwan akong nasa bahay.

records.source: It's been said that a pirate's ship, full of plundered gold, shipwrecked here a long time ago.
records.translation: Sinasabing noong unang panahon ay nawasak dito ang barko ng isang pirata na punô ng ninakaw na ginto.

records.source: Let's not get in a tizzy, now... Gus! I propose a round of drinks to settle the nerves!%noturn
records.translation: Huwag muna tayong mataranta... Gus! Iminumungkahi kong uminom tayong lahat upang kumalma!%noturn

records.source: Ah, yet another unique day in the valley. Stimulating, to say the least!
records.translation: Ah, isa na namang natatanging araw sa lambak. Talagang nakapagpapasigla!

records.source: @, I was just thinking about you.$l#$e#Maybe you sensed it.$h#$e#So! Tell me about your day.
records.translation: @, iniisip lang kita.$l#$e#Baka naramdaman mo iyon.$h#$e#O siya! Ikuwento mo sa akin ang araw mo.

records.source: I wouldn't mind trying my hand at farming.#$e#The quiet atmosphere of a farm might be a good source of literary inspiration, don't you think?$h
records.translation: Gusto kong subukang magsaka.#$e#Baka maging mahusay na bukal ng inspirasyong pampanitikan ang tahimik na kapaligiran ng bukid, hindi ba?$h

records.source: Oh dear! A tiny crab appears to have made his home in my shirt pocket.$l#$e#That's the trouble with living on the beach.
records.translation: Naku po! Mukhang nanirahan sa bulsa ng kamiseta ko ang isang munting alimango.$l#$e#Iyan ang problema sa pagtira sa dalampasigan.

records.source: My legs are stiff from sitting at my writing desk all night.$s#$e#Sometimes I envy you, @.
records.translation: Naninigas ang mga binti ko dahil buong gabi akong nakaupo sa mesa ng pagsusulat.$s#$e#Minsan ay naiinggit ako sa iyo, @.

records.source: My legs are stiff from sitting at my writing desk all morning.$s
records.translation: Naninigas ang mga binti ko dahil buong umaga akong nakaupo sa mesa ng pagsusulat.$s

records.source: @, when you're around... I feel unusually creative.$l#$e#I know... strange, but it's true.
records.translation: @, kapag narito ka... nagiging higit akong malikhain kaysa karaniwan.$l#$e#Alam ko... kakaiba, pero totoo.

records.source: It gets windy this time of year. Marvelous!$h
records.translation: Mahangin sa panahong ito ng taon. Kahanga-hanga!$h

records.source: I have to remember to water my plants today. And not with sea water this time!
records.translation: Kailangan kong tandaang diligan ang mga halaman ko ngayon. At huwag gamit ang tubig-dagat sa pagkakataong ito!

records.source: You've come to visit me in the cold?#$e#I could do with a respite from my lonely labors.
records.translation: Dinalaw mo ako sa gitna ng lamig?#$e#Makabubuti sa akin ang pahinga mula sa mag-isa kong pagpapagal.

records.source: @, you've trudged through the snow to visit me?#$e#I'm honored!$h
records.translation: @, naglakad ka sa makapal na niyebe upang dalawin ako?#$e#Ikinararangal ko!$h

records.source: People have scraped a living off the sea for thousands of years.#$e#I just go to the grocery store.$s
records.translation: Libo-libong taon nang naghahanapbuhay ang mga tao sa dagat.#$e#Ako ay pumupunta lang sa tindahan ng pagkain.$s

records.source: @, I had a feeling that you would show up.#$e#Perhaps we're connected by an other-worldly thread.$l
records.translation: @, naramdaman kong darating ka.#$e#Marahil ay pinag-uugnay tayo ng isang hiblang mula sa ibang daigdig.$l

records.source: A day can never be boring when you follow the whims of your imagination.$u#$e#Sorry, am I babbling on about nonsense?
records.translation: Hindi kailanman magiging nakababagot ang isang araw kapag sinusunod mo ang kapritso ng imahinasyon mo.$u#$e#Paumanhin, puro walang-kabuluhan na ba ang sinasabi ko?

records.source: Breathe deeply. Do you notice it? That's the smell of the sea.#$e#How does it make you feel?
records.translation: Huminga nang malalim. Napapansin mo ba? Iyan ang amoy ng dagat.#$e#Ano ang ipinadarama nito sa iyo?

records.source: Breathe deeply. Do you notice it? That's the smell of the sea.#$e#Whenever I smell the sea, it reminds me of my youth. The ocean really impressed me as a child.
records.translation: Huminga nang malalim. Napapansin mo ba? Iyan ang amoy ng dagat.#$e#Tuwing naaamoy ko ang dagat, ipinaaalala nito sa akin ang kabataan ko. Talagang humanga ako sa karagatan noong bata ako.

records.source: I have to brush my hair daily, or else it'll clump up into messy knots.#$e#It's a lot of work.#$e#I'm surprised I haven't just shaved it off in a fit of passion.$h#$e#I suppose I am too vain.
records.translation: Kailangan kong suklayin ang buhok ko araw-araw, kung hindi ay magkakabuhol-buhol ito.#$e#Napakaraming asikaso nito.#$e#Nagtataka akong hindi ko pa ito inahit sa isang bugso ng damdamin.$h#$e#Siguro ay masyado akong banidoso.

records.source: I've been doing little indoor exercises, since it's often too cold to go out.#$e#Sorry if it's a little humid in the cabin.$s
records.translation: Nag-eehersisyo ako nang kaunti sa loob dahil madalas ay masyadong malamig sa labas.#$e#Paumanhin kung medyo mahalumigmig sa Kubo.$s

records.source: I really should scrub my floorboards today. I think an algae is starting to form.$s#$e#Do you make time for cleaning?
records.translation: Dapat ko talagang kuskusin ang mga tabla sa sahig ngayon. Sa tingin ko ay nagsisimula nang tumubo ang lumot.$s#$e#Naglalaan ka ba ng oras para maglinis?
